* Package name    : advanced-ip-analyser
  Version         : 2.1.0
  Upstream Author : Daren Loxley <24845841+2E0LXY@users.noreply.github.com>
* URL             : https://github.com/2E0LXY/Advanced-IP-Analyser
* License         : GPL-3.0-or-later
  Programming Lang: Python
  Description     : network inventory, packet analysis, and monitoring utility

 Advanced IP Analyser discovers authorized IPv4 and IPv6 hosts, identifies
 TCP services, records device inventories, and launches common remote-access
 clients. It also provides Wake-on-LAN and confirmed SSH power actions.
 .
 The application includes bounded packet capture and display filtering,
 long-running network observation, passive Wi-Fi monitoring with compatible
 adapters, and a read-only same-host web security audit. A graphical desktop
 interface and command-line tools are included.
 .
 I plan to maintain this package and am seeking a sponsor for its initial
 upload. The application is intended only for networks and systems the user is
 authorized to administer.
